summary: Animal Farm is examined closed book with no printed extract, so all 20 practice questions badged Extract Analysis are now Quotation Analysis. Twelve stems and eight mark schemes lost their extract wording; three stems that named an extract without giving one now carry a quotation copied from the same lesson body (the medal 'Animal Hero, First Class', the lettering on the knacker's van, and the animals being 'enormously relieved' by Squealer's hospital story).
